mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a monthly reading, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based contraction in the real economy, which triggers a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both decline by >0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO and HOUST both decline by >0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high housing market activity (HOUST > 1300 thousand units), consumer confidence and disposable income growth accelerate, driving higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where HOUST exceeds 1300 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past month indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where RSAFS increases by at least 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) falls below 50,000 jobs, it signals weak labor market growth that dampens consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS growth is below 50,000.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which boosts corporate profits and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where INDPRO increases by at least 0.5%.
